title: Is Jesus the Only Way?
content: Jesus declared that He is the only way to the Father. Christianity teaches that salvation comes through faith in Jesus Christ alone because He alone paid the penalty for sin through His death and resurrection.

title: Can Salvation Be Lost?
content: Some Christians believe true believers are eternally secure, while others believe a person can fall away through persistent unbelief. The Bible emphasizes perseverance in faith and trust in Christ.

title: Faith vs Works
content: Salvation is by grace through faith, not by works. However, genuine faith produces good works as evidence of transformation. Works are the fruit of salvation, not the cause.

title: What Is Heaven Like?
content: Heaven is described as the dwelling place of God where there is no pain, sorrow, or death. It is a place of joy, righteousness, and eternal fellowship with God.
